name: Camila Phillips
source:
Your mother, despite her airy optimistic nature you know she’s seen some very dark times. You can hear her whimper in her sleep, though she’ll vehemently deny it. She's content to read romantic stories and daydream until reality catches her attention.

[From [url=https://jaimescribblesgames.com/2018/01/19/as-we-know-it/]Jaime Scribbles Games[/url]]
